Climate talks reach a deal

By Jane Doe

Negotiators from almost 200 countries agreed on new emissions targets late on Friday, after two weeks of talks.

What was agreed

The deal commits richer nations to deeper cuts by 2035 and sets up a fund for countries hit hardest by floods and droughts.

“This is the best deal we could get,” said the conference president.

Campaigners said it did not go far enough & called for faster action on coal.
